deadline.value: Apply by 15 January 2027 for September 2027 entry (same date for international applicants).
deadline.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline15 January 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No prior commitment is needed; faculty review applications by research fit, and contacting them is encouraged.
supervisor.quote: No commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary, but contacting faculty members is encouraged. | Faculty members will review applications based on research interests and availability of student positions during the application/evaluation process.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years (from September 2026).
funding.quote: All full-time students in UBC-Vancouver PhD programs will be provided with a funding package of at least $40,000 for each of the first four years of their PhD from September 2026.

entry_route.value: Apply with a thesis-based master's, or directly from a bachelor's with first-class standing and strong research evidence.
entry_route.quote: Admission to the PhD Program with a Previous Undergraduate Degree | This is also known as a direct entry PhD. | A first class standing in your bachelor's degree and evidence of prior research ability.

gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: | The GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 overall (old 120-point scale) or 5.0 on the new 6-point scale; section minimums apply.
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 100

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall, with section minimums.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) | Overall score requirement: 7.0
